description: Safety check of any Solana token before an agent buys it: name, symbol, supply, decimals, token program and extensions, mint and freeze authority, mutable metadata, top-10 holder concentration, holder count, price, liquidity, market cap, organic volume and verification. Returns a 0-100 risk score with every red flag explained. On-chain data from Helius, market data from Jupiter. Price: 0.005 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"solana_token_check"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/crypto/token?mint=JUPyiwrYJFskUPiHa7hkeR8VUtAeFoSYbKedZNsDvCN
